notes.title: Small Update (Typos)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just a quick update to fix some typos pointed out by Sootopolis. Thanks!

Also, if you're having trouble getting the High Price ending and keep getting Echo instead:

[spoiler]That's because the goblets are somewhat random. You'll know you're getting the Echo ending if the player feels cold from drinking from the goblet. Scroll back and pick a different goblet. The player should feel warm.[/spoiler].

I'll add this to the guide later.

notes.title: Fix for Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
This update should fix Steam achievements not working (in-game achievements still worked).

The previous version (1.15) is still available if you encounter any issues. Go to Properties>Betas and select 1.15 in the dropdown menu. 

Happy Halloween/spooky games season, btw.

notes.title: Updated Engine Version
notes.notes:
Hello,

Updates [i]Goblet of Mercy[/i] to the latest version of the Ren'Py engine version, 8.02 to the latest, 8.2.1.

If you experience trouble with this version, the previous version, 1.14a, is still available. To access, select Properties...>Betas>1.14a from the dropdown menu.

It seems like version 8.0.2 of the engine may have had some issues with Steam Deck compatibility, so I'm updating in the hope that that will fix it.

Is anyone else playing [i]Goblet of Mercy[/i] on Steam Deck? I did aim to make text and UI more Steam Deck friendly but haven't been able to test it myself.

Thanks,
S. A. Welland
(Artist/Writer)
[url=https://sunlabyrinth.com]Sun Labyrinth[/url]

notes.title: Update Nov 24 (Adds Spanish Translation)
notes.notes:
Hello,

This update adds a Spanish (Castilian) translation courtesy of Ana Alcocer!

Languages can be changed by navigating to the Preferences section and selecting Spanish (Español) from the menu.

That's all for now.

S. A. Welland
Writer/Illustrator
